title: Georgia Tech And Amazon Launch Science Hub For AI, Robotics, And Logistics Research
key_facts: Georgia Tech and Amazon launched the Georgia Tech-Amazon Science Hub
Amazon will fund joint research and community-building
Initial areas: autonomous systems, next-generation logistics infrastructure, low-Earth-orbit communications
Georgia Tech also joins the Fauna Robotics ecosystem and will use its Sprout research platform
Amazon says it has invested more than $30 billion in Georgia since 2010
quote_evidence: Georgia Tech and Amazon have launched the Georgia Tech-Amazon Science Hub, expanding a decade-long research relationship between the university and technology company.
The initial research areas will focus on autonomous systems, next-generation logistics infrastructure, and low-Earth-orbit communications.
why_it_matters_hint: Amazon is putting research money into robotics and logistics at a leading engineering university.
notes: Announcement-style article with company quotes; no funding amount stated.
